title: Careers: why
description: Section from the approved design, used on: Careers.

intro.default: At a small CRO, you see every study from protocol to report, and the people leading the company work alongside you.

default.p: Schedules planned around studies and around your life, with a team that covers for each other.
Hands-on training from colleagues with 15 to 20+ years in preclinical research, across in vivo, surgical and in vitro work.
Scientists and technicians work side by side, and you'll talk with clients about the science, not just run protocols.
Our leaders serve on local science education and industry boards, and we encourage the team to get involved too.
